I submitted a portfolio of the 100 signals with the highest training Sharpe, weighted in proportion to each signal's training Sharpe. It had a training Sharpe of about 1.52, but it did not pass validation (FAIL on 2000–2012). So I have no evidence it works out of sample, and the high training Sharpe is probably selection bias from picking the best of 423 signals.

I used only 7 of the 200 backtest calls. The top-20, top-50 and top-100 portfolios all failed validation. So did the equal-weight portfolios of each signal family and of all 423 signals. The submission is the top-100 portfolio, which had the highest training Sharpe of the ones I tried.
